[b]I absolutely loved the old [i]Drug Wars[/i] games, and always felt that someone should do a modern remake.[/b] I've even toyed with making one myself. So naturally, I was psyched to hear about [i]The Dope Game[/i]. While this title is a competent remake/modern version of the old game, it just could be better in so many ways. I mean, the buy-low-sell-high premise is painfully simple to recreate (you don't even need artwork), but the envelope needs to be pushed further to add in QoL bells-and-whistles. 

I've tried to get into this title several several times over the course of years, and everytime I play it only takes about 10 minutes and my mind starts drifting and I lose interest. If pressed, I could come up with a full list of issues I have, or ways to just simply make the game better, but I'm not going to do that here. I'll just note that the most important screen in the game is the buy and sell menu. I find it awkward to use. Here are notes:
[list]
[*]Why not have a second column showing how many (if any) drugs I own? This would make it super easy to do the transaction. As-is, I have to either look in the backpack or click on each drug. Maybe this is a feature you buy later on (I don't know), but it just seems like something so fundamental.
[*]Make things functional. Color the name of each drugs text for an additional layer of connecting my mind more quickly to what is being offered. Like, oh I don't know, make cocaine always in bright red text.
[*]The slider-looking buttons are awkward. Honestly it'd just be easier to redesign the whole menu to make it more functional. Why can't I make multiple transactions all at once? 
[/list]

[b]Anyways, I just think this kind of game is super easy to make, so I find it frustrating that the UI and design decisions couldn't have been more functional.[/b] I would prefer to play the old text-based ones over this to be honest. And I wish that weren't the case.

[b]Pros:[/b]
+From looking at dev posts and updates, this is obviously a labor-of-love
+The artwork is unique
+The humor is great
+Price point is fine

[b]Cons:[/b]
-Simple idea drug down by awkward UI and overall system (pun intended)
-I don't particularly like the artwork

[b]I just think making a [i]Drug Wars[/i] clone is low hanging fruit.[/b] I would have liked to see more design decisions geared towards functionality.

The game looked pretty exciting on the store page and they really did a good job both with the trailer and with the game info, however the gameplay is pretty underwhelming considering the presentation it offers.

One would think that this is a game about dealing drugs, you take drugs from a person, and you sell them to another, you stack some drugs in your house, maybe you produce some of your drugs, maybe you get high on your drugs, maybe you even get in some fights because of your drugs, that's what you would expect from a 'drug dealing simulator'.

What the game actually is, is just a stock trading simulator in which you buy the so-called 'drugs' online through an app which is supposedly provided by CIA (makes ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ sense), and you sometimes get into RPG type battles with random people, or the unrealistically perceptive cops in the game, because cops always know what a drug dealer looks like and whether or not he has drugs on him. I use the term 'so-called' because you could really replace the drugs in this game with anything and it wouldn't make a single difference in the gameplay.

The main character doesn't even have a house/apartment, he just goes around the town 24/7 with his tablet and backpack supposedly selling and buying drugs, I don't even know how he gets the drugs, the game never shows him receiving them, it just shows him purchasing them online, I suppose they drop from the sky or some ♥♥♥♥, maybe the CIA use their top notch technology to synthesize the drugs directly into his backpack. The cops in this game don't make any sense, they will attack you on sight if you have drugs on you or even legally owned weapons, and they will frisk you if you don't (which is clearly a violation of your rights in almost any state and country), and if you're at the start of the game good luck dealing with them, cause you won't be able to fight them, and you'll almost never get away. It would have really been a great thing adding character stats in the game like speed (so you can get away from the cops without tripping 7 times in a row when you try to escape) or strength (so you could actually handle the cops in fights without having to purchase the ridiculously overpriced weapons). Also, why does this game take the weapon system to the extreme? I'm pretty sure no low-profile drug dealer would ever carry a rocket launcher or a flame thrower in his backpack. (I don't even know how you could fit those into a backpack)

Also, the pricing of the drugs in this game is complete garbage. I mean, I'm not a drug-obssesed junkie, who just wants to snort coke everyday, but I know that a gram of cocaine doesn't cost $20,000. It doesn't matter when or where you buy it, you could get it in North Korea for cheaper than that. Hell, you could probably even get it into space for cheaper than that. I understand that it wasn't an easy game to make, (especially since you guys spent so much time filling all that background story that nobody cares about) but if you are to make a game on drugs, could you at least do some research on the average prices for street drugs? 

And yes, they use the famous 'unit' as quantity measurement, just so they can discount pieces of criticism like this, but for real, that unit could be a gram, an 8 ball, an ounce or even a pound of cocaine and the pricing still wouldn't make sense. And even if we are to talk about the kilos, it still wouldn't make sense either, as the other drugs would be way too cheap. Needles to say, if you were to carry pounds or kilos of drugs in your backpack and walk through the entire town for days on end, you would probably break both your back and shoulders at some point.

I personally can't recommend this game because it's poorly made and not what I expected, I don't really know what I expected from a 2€ game, but I guess I expected something a bit more than a stock trading simulator.

Alright, time for another Review.  I`ll start of with some "good to know`s" before heading to the positive and negative aspects of the game. So first of all, you can`t actively move around the world , you move trough the world  by clicking trough an map with different locations, in almost every location is a person you can interact with, and always another Dealer you can buy or sell your suff at. Many things are randomized, like the Prices of the Drugs, or some Events during the Game. I think, the setting of the Game is very interesting and different than the settings of the most game. But let`s move on to the positive and negative things about this game.

Positive: - Very Interesting Setting
               -  Things like (buying  Guns, recruiting Crew members and more) cost a lot of Money and keep  
                   you motivated as you always want to get more Money with your Business and try out things you haven`t tried
                    out before during an Game......like killing an Nursefor example, or everyone in the whole Game...
               - A lot of randomized events keep every new Game unique,you can find money or drugs randomley from other
                 players for example, but you can also lose stuff and many other events...
               - Many different Endings, to achieve some aren`t that easy and keep you interested as well.
              - Endless and Hardcore Mode, if you want the game to be a bit more challenging, than thats what youre looking 
                 for.
              - Many different Dialogues, which I personally find very well writen, what I mean by that is that some options
                  in the game are quite funny and made me slightly grin....and a few things the old lady has to say....and things
                 she tells you and...does tu you during your bus drives
             - Very cheap price for an fun game, and you can see that the developer of the game really put a lot of effort into
                making the Game.
              

Negative:
                 - As soon as you know how, it isnt a big challenge anymore to raise a lot of money and the Gameplay gets very
                   repetitive.
                 - There are no Quests, it`s always the same, paying the loan shark back (or not) and then doing your dealing
                     business, while trying to avoid the Police. (Well, maybe you don`t try to avoid the police. ;))

But all in all you get for this price an funny and interesting Game, which definitely is unique in its  own way. It can get an bit repetitive , but all the randomized events and different varieties of modes keep you entertained for an while. 

I rate this game an 8/10....it`s not a game to play 24/7 but its definitely a game for in-between. And it`s being constantly updated.
